title: Senior Salesforce Developer
overview: As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced Salesforce solutions to support our business processes. This role involves leveraging your 2+ years of experience to collaborate with cross-functional teams, deliver high-quality solutions, and enhance system efficiency. You will drive innovation by optimizing Salesforce features and ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. We are committed to fostering a growth-oriented environment where your expertise will be valued, and opportunities for further professional development will be available.
responsibilities: Design and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and other development tools to meet business requirements.
Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or other integration tools.
Identify system bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve Salesforce application performance and scalability.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Perform unit testing, troubleshoot issues, and ensure solutions meet established standards.
Provide ongoing support for Salesforce applications, resolve user issues, and implement system enhancements.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of technical designs, configurations, and processes.
Keep up-to-date with Salesforce platform updates, releases, and best practices to continuously improve solutions.
Support junior developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing code, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

general: Proficiency in Apex, SOQL, and SOSL.
Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce Flows.
Strong understanding of Salesforce Security Models (roles, profiles, sharing rules).
Familiarity with integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft) and APIs (REST/SOAP).
Knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools like Git, Jenkins, or Copado.
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks.

qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
2+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development and administration.
roleImpact: As a Mid-Level Salesforce Developer, you will directly impact the organization's success by designing and delivering robust Salesforce solutions that streamline business operations and drive efficiency. You will be a key contributor to technology-driven initiatives, ensuring Salesforce applications align with business goals and provide exceptional user experiences.
softSkills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Proactive mindset with an eagerness to learn and adapt to new challenges.
certifications: Additional Salesforce certifications (e.g., Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant) are a plus.
training: We value professional growth and provide opportunities for continuous learning. You will have access to advanced training programs, certifications, and mentorship to deepen your expertise in Salesforce development and related technologies. By joining our team, you will be empowered to excel and advance in your career.

title: Business Analyst
overview: As a Business Analyst, you will play a vital role in bridging the gap between business needs and technology solutions. You will work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and support the successful delivery of projects and initiatives. Success in this position involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency, enhance user experiences, and drive business outcomes.
responsibilities: Conduct discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications.
Create detailed process maps, user journeys, and workflow diagrams to visualize and optimize business operations.
Document business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
Perform gap analysis and identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
Collaborate with project managers, developers, designers, and stakeholders to ensure business requirements are accurately implemented.
Assist in solution design discussions and validate proposed solutions against business needs.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by creating test scenarios, coordinating testing activities, and documenting outcomes.
Prepare user guides, training materials, and conduct training sessions to support the successful adoption of new processes and systems.
Monitor project progress, identify risks or dependencies, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and KPIs to measure business performance and project success.

general: Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies and best practices.
Experience in Requirement Gathering, Process Mapping, GAP Analysis, and Documentation.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to facilitate workshops and engage with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
Experience working with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Trello, Asana, Zoho, or similar platforms.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities.

qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in Business Analysis, Process Improvement, Project Coordination, or a related role.
Experience working on software implementation, digital transformation, or technology projects is preferred.
roleImpact: As a Business Analyst, you will contribute to the company's growth by ensuring business needs are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions. Your role is critical in improving processes, supporting successful project delivery, and helping the organization achieve its strategic objectives through data-driven decision-making and operational excellence.
training: We are committed to your professional growth and development. On-the-job training and mentorship will be provided to help you strengthen your business analysis, process improvement, and project delivery skills. You will have access to resources and support from experienced professionals to build a successful career in business analysis and consulting.

title: Fullstack Developer
overview: We are looking for a motivated and skilled Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic engineering team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in both frontend (React.js) and backend (Node.js or similar frameworks), along with a solid understanding of databases, APIs, and scalable application architecture. You will be responsible for developing end-to-end web applications, ensuring seamless integration between frontend and backend systems, and delivering high-performance, scalable solutions.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using React.js and Node.js (or similar backend frameworks).
Build reusable, modular, and scalable frontend components.
Develop secure and optimized RESTful APIs.
Integrate frontend interfaces with backend services and databases.
Design and manage database schemas (SQL or NoSQL).
Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms (JWT, role-based access).
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security.
Troubleshoot bugs across the stack and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Participate in code reviews and maintain clean, maintainable code.
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and QA teams.
Write technical documentation for APIs and components.

frontend: Strong proficiency in React.js and JavaScript (ES6+).
Understanding of component lifecycle and hooks.

niceToHave: Experience deploying applications to cloud environments.
Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, Cypress).
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.
1-3 years of hands-on experience in full stack development.
roleImpact: As a Full Stack Developer, you will play a key role in building scalable, secure, and high-performing applications that directly impact business efficiency and user experience. You will contribute to both frontend innovation and backend robustness, ensuring end-to-end product excellence.
softSkills: Ability to work independently and in team environments.
Proactive mindset and eagerness to learn.
growth: Scaling applications in real-world production environments.

title: SEO Executive
overview:
We are looking for a data-driven SEO Specialist to join our growing marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for improving organic visibility, driving qualified traffic, and generating leads through modern search optimization strategies. Beyond traditional SEO, you will help optimize content for AI-powered search experiences, answer engines, and emerging search technologies.

You will work closely with content, design, and development teams to enhance website performance, improve search rankings, and maximize visibility across search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms.
responsibilities: Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitor research to identify growth opportunities.
Develop and execute On-Page, Off-Page, and Technical SEO strategies.
Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and site architecture for improved search visibility.
Create and implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to improve visibility in AI-powered search experiences.
Optimize content for Google AI Overviews, featured snippets, People Also Ask sections, and zero-click searches.
Collaborate with content teams to create high-quality, search-friendly, and user-focused content.
Implement structured data and schema markup to improve content discoverability.
Monitor website performance, keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversion metrics.
Conduct regular SEO audits and recommend technical improvements.
Build and manage high-quality backlink acquisition campaigns using ethical SEO practices.
Analyze website performance using analytics and SEO tools and provide actionable recommendations.
Stay updated with search engine algorithm updates, AI search developments, and industry best practices.
Prepare monthly performance reports and growth recommendations.

seoAndAiSearchOptimization: Strong understanding of On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, and Technical SEO.
Knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
Experience optimizing content for Google AI Overviews, featured snippets, and voice search.
Understanding of search intent, semantic search, and entity-based SEO.
Familiarity with E-E-A-T principles (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness).
Experience implementing structured data and schema markup.
Knowledge of website crawling, indexing, Core Web Vitals, and site performance optimization.
toolsAndAnalytics: Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with AI-powered SEO and content optimization tools.
general: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to manage projects and deadlines.
Data-driven mindset with attention to detail.
Ability to adapt to changing search technologies and trends.

qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Content Optimization, or Digital Marketing.
Experience working with B2B, SaaS, technology, or professional services businesses is preferred.
Basic understanding of content marketing and conversion optimization is a plus.
roleImpact: As an SEO Specialist, you will play a key role in increasing brand visibility, driving organic growth, and supporting lead generation efforts. Your work will directly impact website traffic, content performance, and business growth while helping the company adapt to the evolving landscape of AI-powered search.
training: We are committed to continuous learning and professional growth. You will have opportunities to work on diverse SEO and digital marketing projects, learn advanced optimization strategies, explore AI search technologies, and collaborate with experienced marketing and technology professionals.
